The Mysterious Lab is where you begin the prologue of Fallout: London and its first main story quest, [Broken Angel](#loc=606708). The route through the lab is fairly linear, but there is an easy-to-miss side room near the start. After breaking out of the pod and leaving the starting room, follow the corridor and check the room to your left before continuing onward. Inside, you’ll find a Team FOLON terminal with thank-you messages from the developers. 

Later, after picking up the Torch, the path takes you through another lab area with a Chemistry Station. Before taking the elevator up into [The Shard](#loc=390696), you can also find a sleeping bag nearby.

*Note: The Mysterious Lab is located beneath [The Shard](#loc=390696). After finishing the prologue, you can return to the lab by re-entering through The Shard.*
